scope: Bounded execution checks, not full training or benchmark evaluation
excluded_optional_tests: test_kitti_overlap_backend.py: its optional rotate_iou_cpu module was not installed
kitti_refactor_compatibility: Pre-refactor state dict loaded strictly; every synthetic train/eval output and attention tensor was bitwise identical
checks_passed_for_both_variants: Initial eval equals original LiDAR features at every pyramid level
Frozen LiDAR state is unchanged after smoke optimization
Camera backbone, FPN, bottleneck, auxiliary and residual parameters update
Detection-only backward reaches camera and LiDAR after unfreezing
Camera candidate weight sums normalize over valid views/heights
Prediction produces nonempty finite boxes with labels in [0,9]
caution: Immediate full masking on the initial frozen detector produces very large but finite classification losses. Production retains two no-mask epochs and a ramp; the smokes do not establish stability at that transition, convergence, camera benefit, mAP or NDS. A monitored pilot should precede an unattended long run.
